notes.title: Update 3.0 - mini map item markers
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27606503/f71fe94e284ed1f4d04c7570895bc2f57395cb0e.jpg[/img]

Mini Map Item Markers

This is actually only one update, but it will have a significant impact on progression in the game.  All quest items (except for a few) will now show on the mini map as they become active in the game.  This should make the game highly playable and more interesting as the story unfolds.

I realized the game was pretty hard to locate some items, but with this new update you will be able to complete the harder quests more easily and be able to complete the game in probably 5-10 hours.

This update is only available for PC at the moment, but I will release the Mac and Linux version soon!

notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27606503/c69b413d2ab736a2b2131a24d230e6cd05a3c389.jpg[/img]Since the first day of release I've been accepting feedback and making changes.  Thanks for all the input!  Here's some of the patches since release:

• improved character kinematics
• replaced untextured bridges with better visuals
• changed intro storyline dialogue
• adjusted audio volume during splash screen
• colliders added to scene 2
• smoothed terrain in areas
• added hd textures to center rock area
• changed tree textures for improved visuals
• moved some objects to objectives
• added tips during intro dialogue for controls 
• changed default graphics settings
• tested game play areas for functionality
• and more

I'll plan on releasing updates every week.  Thanks!
